title: erysimum occidentale
intro: Erysimum occidentale, commonly known as Western wallflower, is a flowering plant species in the family Brassicaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help protect against various diseases and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Western wallflower include isothiocyanates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-cancer and anti-depressant effects. Western wallflower has been traditionally used for its therapeutic actions, including wound healing, pain relief, and respiratory health support.
